Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates thin vertical lucent streaks outlining the mediastinal structures (pneumomediastinum) and radiolucencies in the soft tissues of the neck and supraclavicular regions (subcutaneous emphysema), with clear lung fields lacking consolidation or effusion, which is characteristic of primary spontaneous pneumomediastinum.
